memory.title: Prompt translation token guard fails on bidi/full‑width tokens, falsely reporting preserved tokens missing and forcing English fallback
memory.root_cause: Over‑strict token regexes in src/prompt/util/translation-token-guard.util.ts (lines 18–19) that only accept ASCII {}/[] and plain ASCII identifier characters with optional whitespace, rejecting visually preserved tokens with Unicode directionality marks or full‑width bracket forms that some translations introduce.
memory.fix_summary: The guard’s ASCII-only regexes failed to match tokens when translations inserted bidi marks or used full-width brackets, causing false mismatches. I extended the placeholder and audio-tag regexes to accept full-width bracket variants and ignore Unicode bidi marks, and strip those marks during extraction/normalisation.
